notes.title: Ecchi Jack is available now!
notes.content:
Finally, the game is released! That was a tough week. Here are some improvements compared to the beta-version:
- Jiggle physics for all girls.
- Steam achievements.
- New input scheme for H-scenes.
- Voice acting in H-scenes.
- The game's difficulty was lowered.
- A cheat-code to get additional chips.

We hope that you enjoy the game. And, of course, good luck!
